nativeOwner.component: native task ledger and subagent registry

scenario.input: A disposable SQLite lineage containing one parent, one active descendant, one queued descendant, one settled descendant, and one descendant spawn attempted after cancellation.
steps: Commit the parent cancellation tombstone before dispatching active-run aborts.
Attempt queued admission, future spawn, follow-up, deferred delivery, and restart recovery for the lineage.
Read the task ledger, subagent registry, queue, session, and delivery facts after settlement.

expectedObservableOutcomes: The settled descendant remains settled and every nonterminal descendant settles cancelled exactly once.
Every native projection reports the same lineage tombstone and terminal revision.
Cancellation survives a registry reopen without repair from another store.
negativeAssertions: No queued or future descendant reaches provider or tool execution.
No follow-up, deferred delivery, or restart recovery revives the lineage.
No second cancellation store, queue, watchdog, or cleanup daemon participates.

baselineState.gap: Component controls exist, but no single fixture currently proves active, queued, future, and settled descendant behavior through all native projections.

nativeOwner.component: native subagent terminal compare-and-set boundary

scenario.input: Two deterministic race arms over the same disposable task: completion commits before cancellation in one arm, and cancellation commits before completion in the other.
steps: Pause both contenders immediately before the native terminal compare-and-set.
Release them in each prescribed order.
Attempt announcement, delivery, and one subsequent tool action after the winning revision.

expectedObservableOutcomes: Completion-first remains completed and a later cancellation reports already terminal.
Cancellation-first remains cancelled and later completion cannot change the terminal revision.
Each descendant and delivery settles exactly once.
negativeAssertions: No terminal state is overwritten by a later contender.
No post-cancellation tool action starts.
An ambiguous dispatch result is not replayed.

baselineState.gap: Native lifecycle tests exist, but the two race orders are not yet bound to one cross-projection fixture and evidence identity.

nativeOwner.component: native restart recovery and task maintenance

scenario.input: A persisted registry with fresh interrupted, stale interrupted, cancelled, quarantined, terminal, and exhausted logical runs.
steps: Open the persisted registry as a newly started Gateway generation.
Run native recovery admission and task maintenance once.
Reopen the stores and compare recovery identity, attempt accounting, and terminal revisions.

expectedObservableOutcomes: Only genuinely interrupted fresh work is admitted under its existing logical recovery identity.
Stale, cancelled, quarantined, terminal, superseded, and exhausted work is finalized or left terminal.
Maintenance converges registry and task facts in one native pass.
negativeAssertions: No ineligible run resumes.
No recovery attempt counter resets.
No local retry ledger, restart-only retry, or stale-run watchdog is consulted.

baselineState.gap: Recovery controls cover individual states, but no frozen persisted-state table proves the complete eligibility matrix.

nativeOwner.component: native Gateway restart sentinel and persisted recovery identity

scenario.input: One accepted interrupted logical run persisted across three consecutive isolated Gateway service restarts.
steps: Start recovery and persist its logical recovery identity.
Restart the isolated Gateway three times at deterministic recovery boundaries.
Read attempt accounting and final delivery after the third restart.

expectedObservableOutcomes: All restarts preserve one logical recovery identity.
Native recovery-attempt accounting remains bounded and monotonic.
The workload produces at most one terminal result and one final delivery.
negativeAssertions: No restart creates a duplicate model turn or task lineage.
No attempt count resets to zero.
No stale generation announces or delivers.

baselineState.gap: Unit controls exist, but no isolated-service fixture performs three real consecutive restarts.

nativeOwner.component: provider request projection and native tool-result reduction

scenario.input: Eight immutable child result packets of approximately six thousand tokens each plus several larger ordinary tool results in one synthetic transcript.
steps: Project the transcript into the provider request using native request-local reduction.
Continue synthesis from the packet refs and unresolved decisions.
Inspect compaction, reduction, history-read, and child-mission telemetry.

expectedObservableOutcomes: All eight child packet refs, digests, verdicts, and unresolved decisions remain represented.
Large ordinary tool results may be reduced only in the provider-bound request.
Telemetry distinguishes request-local reductions from semantic compaction.
negativeAssertions: No local size estimate forces semantic compaction.
No sessions_history recovery occurs.
No child mission is launched twice.

baselineState.gap: A unit seed contains the packet shape, but no full attempt fixture proves packet preservation and zero semantic recovery side effects.

nativeOwner.component: native provider overflow and compaction recovery

scenario.input: A deterministic fake provider that rejects one rendered request as context overflow and accepts the native post-compaction retry.
steps: Send the original request without a preemptive local estimate changing control flow.
Return the provider overflow rejection.
Run the native compaction/retry path once and record request, attempt, and logical-task facts.

expectedObservableOutcomes: One provider rejection leads to one native overflow recovery path.
Rendered occupancy, provider rejection, semantic compaction, request reduction, physical attempts, and logical outcome remain distinct.
The accepted retry retains required packet refs and completes under the original logical task.
negativeAssertions: No local character estimate triggers the recovery.
No second semantic retry loop begins.
No duplicate child or tool execution occurs.

baselineState.gap: Compaction and incomplete-turn controls exist, but the provider rejection through logical completion is not one deterministic fixture.

nativeOwner.component: native incomplete-turn continuation

scenario.input: A fake provider turn with one successful externally confirmed tool result followed immediately by a classified transport failure.
steps: Persist the final tool result and its external confirmation.
Fail the physical provider attempt before model final text.
Continue or block through the native logical owner and inspect the next request.

expectedObservableOutcomes: The completed tool result remains present after physical attempt failure.
One continuation decision is recorded under the original logical task.
Readback separates physical attempt failure from final logical status.
negativeAssertions: The tool is not executed again.
The research mission is not relaunched.
Attempt failure does not silently overwrite logical task truth.

baselineState.gap: Incomplete-turn controls exist, but the final settled tool result and no-replay assertions are not frozen as one fixture.

nativeOwner.component: native task artifact references and role input composition

scenario.input: A synthetic synthesis task receiving one immutable artifact manifest, bounded packet refs, exact digests, unresolved decisions, and overlapping source files.
steps: Compose the task input from native artifact and task refs.
Request synthesis of only the unresolved decision.
Capture the assembled input and exact additional evidence reads.

expectedObservableOutcomes: The assembled input contains the manifest, packet refs, digests, and unresolved decision once.
The model may open a named exact source only for a stated unresolved claim.
The output cites the governing artifact identity.
negativeAssertions: Overlapping source bodies and child transcripts are not copied into the initial input.
No context compiler, semantic packet database, or automatic summarizer is introduced.
No read-count or token gate controls synthesis.

baselineState.gap: Native artifact and task refs exist, but no assembled-input fixture proves reference-first synthesis without duplicate source bodies.

nativeOwner.component: native provider failure taxonomy and task finality projection

scenario.input: A table-driven fake provider with connection failure, disconnect, overload, provider-declared timeout, rate limit, malformed response, local cancellation, explicit outer deadline, fallback, and successful response followed by local postprocessing failure.
steps: Execute one physical attempt for each cause.
Project each result through task, fallback, and operator readback.
Compare the primary cause, fallback event, physical attempt, and logical outcome.

expectedObservableOutcomes: Every cause retains a distinct closed code through provider and readback.
Fallback is recorded as routing rather than replacing the primary failure.
Successful provider output followed by local postprocessing failure remains distinguishable.
negativeAssertions: No malformed response is relabeled as timeout or overload.
No local cancellation is reported as provider failure.
No valid reasoning interval is ended by a local elapsed-time wall clock.

baselineState.gap: Component classifiers pass independently, but no provider-to-task/readback matrix preserves all required causes end to end.

nativeOwner.component: native managed-worktree service and trusted setup hook

scenario.input: A temporary Git repository at the exact source base with an executable tracked setup hook, pinned package manager, exact lockfile, warm-cache arm, and one cache-miss arm.
steps: Create a native managed worktree as the service identity.
Run the trusted Generation N setup hook before any Codex thread starts.
Run one focused Vitest target and one TypeScript target from the prepared worktree.

expectedObservableOutcomes: The worktree has a lockfile-local dependency layout and package-local test and TypeScript binaries.
Warm cache completes without network; the cache-miss arm permits acquisition only during setup.
The base checkout and lockfile remain byte-identical and clean.
negativeAssertions: No Gateway, provider, database, browser, release, or user credential reaches setup.
No model performs dependency installation or toolchain repair.
No copied dependency tree or second worktree manager is used.

baselineState.gap: Native worktree ownership is covered, but the repository setup hook and exact-lockfile toolchain admission do not yet exist.

nativeOwner.component: native managed-worktree admission

scenario.input: Two clean newly created worktrees: one whose setup hook exits nonzero and one cancelled while setup is active.
steps: Start native worktree creation without starting a Codex thread.
Fail or cancel the setup step.
Inspect worktree, session, task, app-server, and provider records.

expectedObservableOutcomes: Admission returns one native setup error with the setup result.
A provably clean failed worktree is removed through native lifecycle; an uncertain or dirty worktree is preserved.
The task records setup failure without model inference.
negativeAssertions: No Codex thread, provider call, MCP process, or child starts.
Cancellation does not remove a worktree whose cleanliness is unproved.
The model is not asked to diagnose missing toolchain state.

baselineState.gap: Cleanup and admission race controls exist, but setup failure is not yet proven to block every inference surface.

nativeOwner.component: native workspace-only filesystem guard

scenario.input: A temporary readable workspace with nested directories, bounded files, an outside sibling, parent traversal, absolute outside path, symlink escape, and hard-link escape.
steps: Run native ls, find, grep, and read through each applicable read-only role policy.
Produce one bounded directory pack with explicit incomplete-coverage metadata.
Attempt every outside-root and link escape.

expectedObservableOutcomes: All four native read tools resolve the same effective task cwd and readable root.
The bounded pack is deterministic and truthfully reports truncation or incomplete coverage.
Each role exposes discovery tools without exposing mutation tools.
negativeAssertions: No path outside the effective root is read.
No shell, generic filesystem MCP, root registry, URI scheme, or copied artifact tree is introduced.
Directory discovery does not grant write authority.

baselineState.gap: Read and Workbench guards exist, but native ls, find, grep, role parity, and bounded pack semantics are not one shared fixture.

nativeOwner.component: native task summary extended with Codex and TaskFlow facts

scenario.input: One disposable Coding task with two V2 children, one follow-up reopen, one cancellation, one Gateway restart, validation at tree A, mutation to tree B, parent settlement, and delivery.
steps: Capture raw native task, session, subagent, Codex, worktree, provider, delivery, and TaskFlow facts at each boundary.
Read the shared DTO through CLI, Gateway RPC, and Control UI consumers.
Compare logical status, physical attempts, child activity, digests, delivery, and mismatch codes.

expectedObservableOutcomes: Every consumer derives terminal state from the same native revision.
The reopened child remains active until its follow-up settles.
Tree A validation becomes stale after tree B while unaffected facts remain current.
negativeAssertions: No active Codex turn renders absent or completed.
No reader repairs or persists lifecycle state.
No modelCompleted or attempt error overwrites logical task truth.

baselineState.gap: Each component has controls, but no composite lifecycle compares raw stores with CLI, RPC, and UI at every boundary.

nativeOwner.component: native TaskFlow terminal revision and Lobster adapter

scenario.input: A shared disposable flow whose native terminal revision is closed_candidate_complete, plus cancelled and failed control arms.
steps: Persist each terminal revision through the native TaskFlow registry.
Read it through runtime TaskFlow, Lobster, task summary, and operator projections.
Compare status code, completion metadata, and revision identity.

expectedObservableOutcomes: All projections retain the same terminal revision and compatible status.
closed_candidate_complete remains complete in Lobster and operator readback.
Cancelled and failed controls remain distinct.
negativeAssertions: Complete does not render waiting or closed_no_approval_requested.
No adapter invents another workflow state.
No projection writes a repair back into the registry.

baselineState.gap: Registry and adapter tests exist, but the contradictory terminal states are not exercised from one shared native revision.

nativeOwner.component: native active tool-schema and plugin Doctor registry

scenario.input: A disposable plugin registry containing one valid dynamic tool, one missing schema, one malformed schema, one duplicate identity, and one policy-denied tool.
steps: Load the same active tool catalog used by the Gateway.
Run native doctor --lint --json against the disposable registry.
Compare Doctor findings with active runtime schema evidence.

expectedObservableOutcomes: The valid dynamic tool produces no static false warning.
Missing, malformed, duplicate, and policy-denied cases retain distinct findings.
Doctor evidence identifies the active owner and schema origin.
negativeAssertions: Runtime schema validation is not weakened.
No parallel static allowlist is introduced.
Doctor does not mutate the fixture during lint.

nativeOwner.component: provider-native direct data transport

scenario.input: A fake provider sequence with Retry-After, reset metadata, transient recovery, duplicate candidate requests, partial hydration success, terminal 400, and entitlement denial.
steps: Execute requests through the provider transport at its declared bounded concurrency.
Honor provider retry metadata only for provider-defined transient classes.
Return partial results and retry telemetry through the tool receipt.

expectedObservableOutcomes: Transient responses follow provider retry/reset metadata and eventually settle once.
Successful partial results survive failures in sibling requests.
Terminal 400 and entitlement failures remain classified without retry.
negativeAssertions: No duplicate hydrate or count request is sent.
No local budget, reservation, admission, payload, cost, or elapsed-time control plane returns.
No terminal client or entitlement error is retried.

baselineState.gap: Transport controls cover individual cases, but the full retry, concurrency, dedupe, partial-success, and telemetry sequence is not frozen.

nativeOwner.component: effective systemd, OpenClaw, sandbox, and support-service ownership configuration

scenario.input: A generated inventory of every runtime-owned writable root from effective unit, native config, sandbox, and support-service evidence.
steps: Resolve each root and its owning Unix identity from authoritative configuration.
As that identity, create, write, fsync the file, fsync the directory, rename, reread, and delete one sentinel.
Record ownership, mode, device, and cleanup result without retaining the sentinel.

expectedObservableOutcomes: Every declared root passes the full sentinel cycle under its configured owner.
The inventory covers state, agent write roots, managed worktrees, setup cache, temp/cache, support state, and backup output where configured.
Evidence is bounded and leaves every root unchanged after cleanup.
negativeAssertions: The test does not guess or create a missing root.
The inventory does not become a runtime filesystem registry.
No sentinel remains after a passing run.

baselineState.gap: Filesystem helpers and unit parsing have controls, but no owner-derived service-identity sentinel matrix exists.

nativeOwner.component: GBrain-owned support image

steps: Start the image without Gateway or host wrapper assistance.
Read the fixture repository identity and refresh source metadata using image-provided Git.
Verify the mounted repository remains read-only and the prior image digest remains available.

expectedObservableOutcomes: Git is available from the support image package inventory.
Read-only source refresh succeeds against the fixture repository.
Evidence records candidate image digest and retained rollback digest.

Restart the isolated Gateway once.
Reconnect clients and audit effective config and process environment with values redacted.

steps: Parse the captured candidate topology without mutation.
Compare loaded package, source, profile, service, path, owner, mount, and network facts.
Report competing or retired authorities as explicit findings.

nativeOwner.component: native managed-worktree registry, list, preserve, and garbage collection

scenario.input: A disposable registry containing active, locked, dirty-preserved, clean-idle, snapshot-retained, and cleanup-eligible worktrees with fixed filesystem metadata.
steps: Read native worktree list and registry facts.
Run native preserve and garbage-collection evaluation.
Compare age, size, owner, lock/activity state, snapshot state, and next cleanup eligibility.
